name: normal
meaning: 4.12 plane normal in game space (y<0 = floor facing up)

name: pad12
meaning: padding after normal (never read in this module)

name: verts
meaning: three vertices stored as (x, -y, -z) = detector space /16; queries negate y and z to get game space or <<4 for clipping

name: flags
meaning: surface flags (not read by any function of this module)
